facts.fact: Gardenpath 虽在 Memory 练过，用两条手臂直立行走（而非抓地）仍极其别扭；galaxysuit 外还披着仿 Unnamed 纺织品的编织植物材料。
facts.anchor: Though Gardenpath had practiced back at the Memory, it still felt extremely strange to balance on two arms instead of gripping the ground.

facts.fact: 两名 Unnamed 拿着发酵液罐子坐在长椅上看天喝酒，周期性发出振动。
facts.anchor: They carried containers of fermented fluid and sat on a bench, looking at the sky and drinking.

facts.fact: 两个 Unnamed 早先注意到 Gardenpath 手臂发抖，把他们围抱起来拉起身帮忙。
facts.anchor: Apparently the Unnamed had noticed their trembling arms earlier and wanted to help.

facts.fact: 进楼后 Gardenpath 悄悄启动 suit 里的录音器，开始填粉色私笔记本。
facts.anchor: Gardenpath surreptitiously activated the recorder in their suit.

facts.fact: 楼内许多成对 Unnamed reaching inside each other；Gardenpath 皱起身体，拒绝把「这是性」升格为假说——太顺理成章，更像 projection 而非 observation。
facts.anchor: It was too pat an explanation, more like projection than observation.

facts.fact: 名字交换仪式里 Gardenpath 试音出对方叫 Murtis、又用「Wine?」要饮品，Murtis 跳起来从壶里倒酒给他们。
facts.anchor: Murtis jumped up and poured a draft from a jug into a small container for Gardenpath.

facts.fact: 一夜词汇积累：这座楼叫 lupanar，街对面墙上有 lurid red 的「writing」，Unnamed 们围着它大声议论 cunts 和 elections。
破晓送客后，留下的 Unnamed 打扫：用草束扫地，一人下楼把一桶垃圾和 prokaryotes 倒进楼梯下的洞。
facts.anchor: One of them went downstairs to dump a bucket of waste and prokaryotes into a hole beneath the stairs.
